name: Letter and Symbol Series Practice Test

questions.question:
If the symbols followed by consonants interchange their positions within the group, then which element is third from the right end?
(a) U
(b) #
(c) P
(d) 5
(e)  None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - B @ C 7 N R % 5 $ G 6 K M & 4 S # P U 5
After operation – B C @ 7 N R % 5 G $ 6 K M & 4 S P # U 5
So, third element from the right end = #

questions.question:

(b) KS#

(d) C4H

questions.explanation:
Given series - B @ C 7 N R % 5 $ G 6 K M & 4 S # P U 5
So, SPU is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following is second to the left of the twelfth from the right end if all the symbols are dropped?
(a) F
(b) C
(c) 7
(d) M
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - B @ C 7 N R % 5 $ G 6 K M & 4 S # P U 5
After dropping symbols - B C 7 N R 5 G 6 K M 4 S P U 5
So, 12th from the right end – N
Hence, second to the left of N is C.

questions.question:
If the numbers which are preceded by letters interchanged their positions and those letters were changed to the next letter in the alphabetical series, then which of the following elements are the fourth from the left end and the eleventh from the right end?
(a) F and 7
(b) 6 and D
(c) A and $
(d) D and 6
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - B @ C 7 N R % 5 $ G 6 K M & 4 S # P U 5
After operation - B @ 7 C N R % 5 $ 6 G K M & 4 S # P 5 U
After changing - B @ 7 D N R % 5 $ 6 H K M & 4 S # P 5 V
So, fourth from the left end and eleventh from the right end – D and 6
Therefore, option d is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many letters are there which are preceded by a symbol and followed by a number within the group in the given arrangement?
(a) None
(b) One
(c) Two
(d) Three
(e) More than three
questions.explanation:
Given series - B @ C 7 N R % 5 $ G 6 K M & 4 S # P U 5
So, there are two letters (@C7, $G6). Therefore option c is the correct answer.Direction (6-10): Study the following digit-letter-symbol sequence carefully and answer the questions given below. * E 7 O & 6 ^ 4 Z 5 * 3 9 T ! D # 2 $ U

questions.question:
If all the digits are dropped, which of the following is third to the right of the eleventh from the right end?
(a) ^
(b) 8
(c) Z
(d) &
(e) T
questions.explanation:
Given Series - * E 7 O & 6 ^ 4 Z 5 * 3 9 T ! D # 2 $ U
After dropping digits - * E O & ^ Z * T ! D # $ U
So, eleventh from the right end – O
Therefore, third to the right of O – Z

questions.question:
What is the 7th element to the left of the element that is 9th from the right end?
(a) &
(b) C
(c) 2
(d) #
(e) $
questions.explanation:
Given Series - * E 7 O & 6 ^ 4 Z 5 * 3 9 T ! D # 2 $ U
9th from the right end – 3
So, the 7th element to the left of 3 - &
Hence, option a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many digits are there which are preceded by a symbol and followed by a letter?
(a) 0
(b) 1
(c) 2
(d) 3
(e) More than 3
questions.explanation:
Given Series - * E 7 O & 6 ^ 4 Z 5 * 3 9 T ! D # 2 $ U
So, there is one digit (4). Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If all the symbols are removed then what will be the element which is 9th from the left?
(a) 4
(b) 7
(c) 1
(d) 9
(e) None of the above
questions.explanation:
Given Series - * E 7 O & 6 ^ 4 Z 5 * 3 9 T ! D # 2 $ U
After dropping symbols - E 7 O 6 4 Z 5 3 9 T D 2 U
So, 9th from the left end – 9
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many such numbers are there in the given series which are immediately preceded or followed by a consonant?
(a) Three
(b) Four
(c) More than five
(d) Five
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - Y Z # 8 F H 7 $ 3 M O & 9 7 G Q % K X @ 4 6 J I # D T S 8 $
So, there are six such numbers which are immediately preceded or followed by a consonant. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If all the symbols are dropped from the series then which element will be fifth to the right of the one which is fourteenth from the right end of the new arrangement?
(a) G
(b) K
(c) 4
(d) X
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - \text{Y Z \# 8 F H 7 \$ 3 M O \& 9 7 G Q \% K X @ 4 6 J I \# D T S 8 \$}
After dropping symbols - Y Z 8 F H 7 3 M O 9 7 G Q K X 4 6 J I D T S 8
So, fourteenth from the right end – 9
Then, fifth to the right of 9 – X
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following element is 17th to the right of the one which is 24th from the right end of the given arrangement?
(a) I
(b) J
(c) #
(d) T
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series - \text{Y Z \# 8 F H 7 \$ 3 M O \& 9 7 G Q \% K X @ 4 6 J I \# D T S 8 \$}
So, 24th from the right end – 7
Then, 17th to the right of 7 – I
Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many such symbols are there in the given series which are immediately preceded by a consonant but not immediately followed by a consonant?
(a) Four
(b) One
(c) Three
(d) Two
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given series: \text{Y Z \# 8 F H 7 \$ 3 M O \& 9 7 G Q \% K X @ 4 6 J I \# D T S 8 \$}
Two symbols highlighted here, satisfy the given conditions:
Y Z # 8 F H 7 $ 3 M O & 9 7 G Q % K X @ 4 6 J I # D T S 8 $
So, there are four symbols. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.Direction (16-20): Study the following digit-letter-symbol sequence carefully and answer the questions given below. M Z 3 + T # & I H N % 8 $ J Q 1 L M * @ X R 6 4 # D F +

questions.question:
How many such symbols are there in the above arrangement each of which is either immediately followed by a number or immediately preceded by a letter, but not both?
(a) None
(b) One
(c) Two
(d) Three
(e) More than 3
questions.explanation:
Given Series - M Z 3 + T # & I H N % 8 $ J Q 1 L M * @ X R 6 4 # D F +
So, there are three symbols in the above arrangement. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way. Which one does not belong to the group?
(a) 3 Z D F
(b) # T 6 4
(c) M T + 4
(d) # I 6 X
(e) + # 3 D
questions.explanation:
Given Series - M Z 3 + T # & I H N % 8 $ J Q 1 L M * @ X R 6 4 # D F +
In all other groups, the 3rd and 4th elements occupy the same positions from the right in the given arrangement as the first and 2nd elements respectively from the left end.
Hence, option (e) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
3 Z T is to & H % in the same way as Q J L is to?
(a) X R *
(b) * XM
(c) @ * R
(d) @ X L
(e) None of these
questions.explanation:
Given Series - M Z 3 + T # & I H N % 8 $ J Q 1 L M * @ X R 6 4 # D F +
In each pair, the 1st, 2nd and 3rd elements of the 1st term move 4, 7 and 6 step forward respectively to give the corresponding elements of the 2nd term.
Hence, option (e) is the correct answer.
